FAQ

Questions about rmc plant software

Short, direct answers.

What does RMC plant software do?

It manages concrete orders, mix designs, batching records, transit-mixer dispatch, weighbridge data, quality tests and invoicing. Sarvlekh connects all of it so the plant runs from one live board.

Does it integrate with our weighbridge and batching controller?

Yes. We integrate with common weighbridge indicators and can capture batching data for reconciliation.

Can it handle site-wise rates and escalation?

Yes. Rate cards, pump and transport charges and escalation clauses are configurable per customer or site.

Can the rmc plant system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the rmc plant system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
